scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && firebase deploy --project buzzit --config firebase.buzzit.json --only hosting:shigotoku-web
scripts.deploy:runwith-app: npm run build && firebase deploy --project runwith --config firebase.runwith.json --only hosting:runwith-app
scripts.deploy:buzzit-app: npm run build && firebase deploy --project buzzit --config firebase.buzzit.json --only hosting:buzzit-app
scripts.deploy:buzzit-api: npm run build:buzzit-api && firebase deploy --project buzzit --config firebase.buzzit.json --only functions:buzzit-api,storage,firestore
scripts.build:buzzit-api: npm ci --prefix ../buzzit/api && npm run build --prefix ../buzzit/api && node scripts/prepare-buzzit-api.mjs
scripts.deploy:buzzit: npm run build && npm run build:buzzit-api && firebase deploy --project buzzit --config firebase.buzzit.json --only hosting,functions:buzzit-api,storage,firestore
scripts.deploy:runwith: npm run build && firebase deploy --project runwith --config firebase.runwith.json --only hosting,storage,firestore
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:buzzit && npm run deploy:runwith
scripts.deploy:all-with-api: npm run deploy:buzzit && npm run deploy:runwith
